pr_comments:
While Testing this I noticed an issue in the downgrade case. We are not removing the data from downgrade and just perform below conversion.
       
```
          ALTER TABLE dag_run
          ALTER COLUMN conf TYPE BYTEA
          USING CASE
              WHEN conf IS NOT NULL THEN CONVERT_TO(conf::TEXT, 'UTF8')
              ELSE NULL
          END
 
```

I am getting `UnpicklingError` error with this when I try to open DAG page.
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/93d7a456-448c-4d60-956d-50cbef968de3)

Should we also move data to the archive table in case of a downgrade as well?
cc: @kaxil

> While Testing this I noticed an issue in the downgrade case. We are not removing the data from downgrade and just perform below conversion.
> 
> ```
>           ALTER TABLE dag_run
>           ALTER COLUMN conf TYPE BYTEA
>           USING CASE
>               WHEN conf IS NOT NULL THEN CONVERT_TO(conf::TEXT, 'UTF8')
>               ELSE NULL
>           END
>  
> ```
> 
> I am getting `UnpicklingError` error with this when I try to open DAG page. ![image](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/43964496/391508491-93d7a456-448c-4d60-956d-50cbef968de3.png?jwt=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..hJxNgnZc2QuLnUp1EPHdb787rac6U-UHX7f2rPZVQl4)
> 
> Should we also move data to the archive table in case of a downgrade as well? cc: @kaxil

issue_context.title: dag_run table - replace column conf type - byte ( that store a python pickle ) by a JSON
issue_context.body:
### Description

the column `conf` of the table `dag_run` is using the type `byte` ( and storing a python pickle ) on the database , since airflow only support postgres 12+ and mysql 8+ , we could use a `json` type .

And also the user could search "efficiently" in the web-ui a dag_run based on the parameters thanks to that change


### Are you willing to submit a PR?

- [ ] Yes I am willing to submit a PR!

review_comments: Do we not need any more handling than these?
Check if the DagRun edit view works in the FAB UI

I think you _might_ need to change this line:

https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/3c1124e054f9d795b0e9007041653888da9de6a8/airflow/www/forms.py#L131-L132

You will also need to add a `newsfragment`, something like:

https://github.com/astronomer/airflow/blob/feb39ed3788e22fd83a1cb294a824e60f4c13187/newsfragments/aip-72.significant.rst#L21-L37

fyi: the following is what I had to do for XComs:

PRs:

1. [Remove XCom pickling](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/43905)
2. [Migrate pickled data & change XCom value type to JSON](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/44166)
3. [Handle XCom value errors in FAB's XCom list view](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/44275)
4. [Use `JSONB` type for `XCom.value` column in PostgreSQL](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/44290)
We no longer need to manually convert the data since the column type is now PickleType. It will automatically do the conversion

we have made conf_picklePickleType [here](https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/95da0825212e4c92dee6d4e13ac6c59a54f5a113/airflow/migrations/versions/0055_3_0_0_remove_pickled_data_from_dagrun_table.py#L101), now from [here](https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/95da0825212e4c92dee6d4e13ac6c59a54f5a113/airflow/migrations/versions/0055_3_0_0_remove_pickled_data_from_dagrun_table.py#L120) we are getting json data from conf column and this needs to be converted [here](https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/95da0825212e4c92dee6d4e13ac6c59a54f5a113/airflow/migrations/versions/0055_3_0_0_remove_pickled_data_from_dagrun_table.py#L129)

I tried earlier it was not getting converted by itself

Tried below as suggested by @ephraimbuddy but did not work, as discussed we can proceed with current approach
```
   try:
            for row in session.query(DagRun).all():
                row.conf_pickle = row.conf
                session.merge(row)
            session.commit()
        except Exception:
            session.rollback()
            raise
        finally:
            session.close()
```
We should take a cue from how we handled the xcom value instead of this. See: https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/airflow/migrations/versions/0049_3_0_0_remove_pickled_data_from_xcom_table.py

@ephraimbuddy My initial implementation was based on [this](https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/airflow/migrations/versions/0049_3_0_0_remove_pickled_data_from_xcom_table.py) only. As per discussion with @kaxil @jedcunningham we opted for this in offline mode.
@jedcunningham could this be an issue with large migration?
This is the same as the one you wrote with Alembic. However, it's just for Postgresql. You would need to tweak it to work; I didn't test it. You also need to write similar SQL for MySQL & sqlite
